memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks to office, no assistance needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait: steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 8 regular. Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional low back pain affecting mood, denies depression.
carers: Spouse, Mr. Rohan Patel.
goal: "I want to manage my pain and kidney health to keep working."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pregabalin 75 mg BD
 diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
 telmisartan 40 mg OD
 dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
 furosemide 20 mg OD
 sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD
 cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum creatinine 1.4 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2)
eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60)
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 120 mg/g (<30)
Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12‑16)
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30‑100)
Serum calcium 9.1 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5)
Serum phosphate 3.8 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Straight leg raise test: Positive at 40° left, 45° right.
Lumbar spine X‑ray: Mild degenerative changes at L4‑L5, no frank fracture.
MRI lumbar spine: Disc bulge L4‑L5 impinging on left S1 nerve root.

memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni.
